reader_summary.overview: Today's show is quite different from our typical show. It's an edited replay of a conversation from six years ago with Michael Mervosh , the Executive Director of the Hero's Journey Foundation. Michael created HJF to provide experiential opportunities for human development and transformation based on Joseph Campbell's mythic hero's journey.

key_points.text: He called alongside someone I didn't know.
He recently retired after two decades as a partner at a very well-regarded, multi-billion-dollar equity manager.
